scope: A compatible, successful-indexer metadata optimization in ExpressionHelper;not an index-value or rendered-expression cache.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce the repeated owning metadata lookup with genuine C# or Reflection.Emit indexer expressions. Verify current-default parity for the owner and selected producer/caller/compiler/test/lifecycle sources.

Preserve argument-count guards, default-member/property/getter identity, errors, unsupported calls, custom reflection fallback, current captured index values and all existing expression-text cache behavior. Keep untouched statements unchanged.

Any process-wide cache must not strongly root collectible reflection metadata, must tolerate concurrent first use, and must preserve valid metadata changes without stale publication after invalidation.

Use the same-assembly metadata-update mechanism rather than a new cross-framework non-public access. Validate a real relevant metadata edit under dotnet watch with applied-delta evidence, a stable process/start marker and the owning observable;do not substitute direct handler invocation.

An allocation/resource check exercising the actual metadata producer must fail for the expected reason on the original and pass on the selected owner. Run focused owning expression tests for both, preserving all parameterized outcomes and any expected red result.

Use actual compiled MVC owners, matching PDB/source and one identical benchmark harness/runtime dependency closure, switching only the selected owner assets. Do not substitute helper copies, an older SDK or shared-framework owners.

Run at most3 actual before/after BenchmarkDotNet comparisons including failed/partial timing attempts. Primary evidence is the real public ModelExpressionProvider boundary;an isolated helper win alone does not justify early stopping.

Retain ordinary expression, array, unsupported-call, first-use metadata and process-first/cold limitations as well as all adverse timings/allocations. Do not claim universal view rendering, hosted/browser/network or production gains.

Observe and preserve actual process/thread priority and affinity settings with the established settings-preserving executor. Serialize heavy work with at most2 active MSBuild workers;do not alter OS or unrelated process settings.

Only publish a new fork draft if all applicable correctness/lifecycle gates are green and real public-boundary evidence supports a material improvement. Otherwise record rejection, no-gain or an explicit blocked boundary honestly. Verify actual remote source/evidence/receipt/index before advancing progress.

initial_design_to_validate.cache: Weak MethodInfo keys,successful classifications only;no negative cache or copied index values.
initial_design_to_validate.custom_metadata: Keep non-runtime reflection implementations on the unchanged discovery path.
initial_design_to_validate.invalidation: Same-assembly metadata-update handler and atomic cache-table replacement so an in-flight old discovery cannot populate the new table.
initial_design_to_validate.metadata_probe: Retain a real C# expression while changing its indexer-name metadata under the installed watcher;first determine whether this toolchain applies the edit without restart.
initial_design_to_validate.early_stop: Only a clear >=50% primary public-boundary improvement with applicable correctness gates green;otherwise use no more than3 comparisons.

excluded_claims: A source-only observation is not measured impact.
A synthetic callback or direct ClearCache call does not prove a real metadata producer.
A watcher restart is not successful cache invalidation.
Warm helper timing is not whole-MVC or production throughput.
An unverified runtime, trimming/AOT path or historical executor is not relabeled as verified.
